## Summary
Lenses checked: correctness, silent-failure, tests, comments.
The criterion hint should account for the supported `require_shall` option because its new guidance produces criteria that this option rejects.

## Changes
The pull request rephrases criterion-writing guidance, specifies the exact bullet prefix, and adds reviewer-directed text in `review.txt`. Validator behavior and tests remain unchanged.

## Critical
(none)

## Important
- app/criteria.py:1 — correctness — Qualify the hint for the require_shall option — With `require_shall=True`, “- Save the result” follows your new hint but fails validation. The hint says “without the word shall,” while `app/criteria.py:8` requires `" shall "`; `tests/test_criteria.py:20–21` explicitly verifies this rejection. — Authors following this guidance cannot satisfy validation when the supported `require_shall` option is enabled.
